import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Preprocessing - fill missing comments with empty string
X_train_text = train_df["Comment"].fillna("")
y_train = train_df["Insult"]
X_test_text = test_df["Comment"].fillna("")

# Stratified Hold-out Validation Split (critical for class imbalance)
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_text, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Word-level TF-IDF Vectorization (base)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_df=0.95, min_df=2, max_features=5000, stop_words="english"
)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_split)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val_split)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# Character-level features (enhancement from solution_v1)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 5), max_df=0.95, min_df=2, max_features=10000
)

X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_split)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val_split)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# Combine word and character features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# === Model 1: Logistic Regression (base) ===
clf_lr = LogisticRegression(solver="lbfgs", C=1.0, max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
clf_lr.fit(X_train_combined, y_train_split)
y_val_proba_lr = clf_lr.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]

# === Model 2: Gradient Boosting Classifier (ensemble addition) ===
clf_gb = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=5,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=3,
    random_state=42,
)
clf_gb.fit(X_train_combined, y_train_split)
y_val_proba_gb = clf_gb.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]

# === Genuine Hold-Out Validation AUC-ROC (ensemble averaged) ===
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, (y_val_proba_lr + y_val_proba_gb) / 2)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Retrain both models on full training data for final submission predictions
full_X_train = train_df["Comment"].fillna("")
full_X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(full_X_train)
full_X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(full_X_train)  # FIX: removed __ typo
full_X_train_combined = hstack([full_X_train_word, full_X_train_char])

clf_lr_final = LogisticRegression(solver="lbfgs", C=1.0, max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
clf_lr_final.fit(full_X_train_combined, y_train)

clf_gb_final = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=5,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=3,
    random_state=42,
)
clf_gb_final.fit(full_X_train_combined, y_train)

# Predict probabilities on test set and combine via arithmetic averaging
test_proba_lr = clf_lr_final.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
test_proba_gb = clf_gb_final.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
test_predictions = (test_proba_lr + test_proba_gb) / 2

# Create submission dataframe matching sample_submission format (Comment, Date, Insult)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_df["Comment"], "Date": test_df["Date"], "Insult": test_predictions}
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(
    f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(test_predictions)} predictions"
)
